data.body: [P2] Preserve the existing public record shape. Adding an eighth component breaks recompilation of Java 21+ consumers using seven-component `InvocationInfo` record patterns. Retaining constructors does not preserve this usage, and the new compatibility test explicitly expects compilation failure. Keep the seven-component record and carry the header through separate immutable metadata with a backward-compatible hook overload that delegates to the existing hook. Update the regression test to require the unchanged legacy pattern to compile successfully.
